column5: Mood: bright, cheerful sports-club pixel art; a sunny gym with a cheering crowd; every move reads at a glance.
Camera and scale: 2D side view of the court, scrolling with the ball (`follow2d`); native 320x180, scaled by whole numbers, pixel smoothing off.
Shapes: chunky big-headed players about two heads tall, each of the three roles its own silhouette (lanky Sharpshooter, low compact Slasher, wide tall Big); round ball, boxy hoop and backboard.
Values: players and ball brightest; court mid-tone; crowd and stands held darker and lower in contrast.
Palette: warm orange court with cream lines, deep blue stands, your team in white and green, theirs in blue and red, the ball bright orange, meter glow yellow; shadows shift cooler.
Detail: on faces, hair and jerseys; the crowd is simple repeated rows.
Rules: one pixel density, thick dark outline on every figure, two-tone shading, every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
Signature: a full special-move meter makes the player flash and the crowd's rows bob.

References: Hoopland (snappy few-frame motion, the flow of a side-view match, the match feel); your four screenshots in `references/` (the proportions, the outlined big-head sprites, the bright court and crowd).
View: 2D · Camera: side view, follows the ball.
3-on-3 full-court match, side view, scrolling with the ball
Three player roles with their own silhouette and one special move each, on a meter filled by good play
Shot timing with a visible sweet spot; a press snaps straight into the pose; a pass pressed early fires when the ball arrives
Teammates spread the floor, cut and shoot when open; switch defender with a key
AI opponents at Easy, Normal and Hard, using the same moves and specials as you
Short clock, two halves of two minutes, score and clock big on screen, then a results screen *(half length provisional)*
Title screen with difficulty select, and Play Again
one special move for each player · in the slice
3 on 3 · in the slice
a short clock · in the slice
AI with different levels of difficulty · in the slice
Title screen: pick a difficulty (Easy, Normal, Hard), press Start.
Tip-off; your Slasher has the ball at the left, the clock reads 2:00.
A prompt shows "arrows move, X pass".
You dribble right, a defender steps up, you pass to the open Sharpshooter; a prompt shows "hold Space, release at the flash".
The shot goes in, the crowd bobs, the score reads 2-0, and the special meter under your player fills a notch.
The AI brings it up; you press Tab to the nearest defender and jump at their shot.
Around the 40-second mark your meter fills, the player flashes, and Shift fires the Slasher's burst drive straight past two defenders into a dunk.
That is the hook landing.
On Normal, after the first two baskets the AI closes out on shooters, jumps lazy passes and runs its own specials when its meter fills; by the second half it doubles your ball handler.
On Hard it does all of that from the tip, and its shooter rarely misses an open look.
On Easy it contests late and never doubles.
There is no catch-up boost: a strict, even contest.
A loss ends the match with the final score and a Play Again button.
*(difficulty tiers guessed)*
